why: The old 20260605_extra OLMSmoother2 legacy PNGs are no longer trusted as correctness targets.
A current Windows AE 2026 Software recapture of old legacy case_0001 produced [106,106,106,135] at witness pixel (712,406), matching the Windows runtime trace and Mac CLI direct-source output.
The old case_0001 PNG produced [207,207,207,207] at the same witness, so the remaining old legacy cases must be recaptured with the current AEX before more tuning.
manifest_requirements: Record AE version, project_gpu_accel_type.current_name and raw value.
Record all OLM Smoother v2 property names, match_names, property_index, values, enabled/active state, and selected effect path.
Keep ADBE Force CPU GPU / GPU Rendering as reference-only metadata, not as the execution-path label.
Save both before_effects_frame and effect output PNG for every case.
Record sampled RGBA values at pixel (712,406) for before_effects_frame and output.
Include the original source input PNG in the return package; do not rely only on AE saveFrameToPng before_effects frames because they may be premultiplied.
Do not reuse old 20260605_extra rendered PNGs as outputs; this request is specifically for current installed AEX output provenance.
